_comment: The curated carrier table. A model may AUTHOR this file; only the arithmetic reads it. A rating decided at query time would make the same search return a different order tomorrow, which is hard rule 1 gone. Every row is reviewed and dated.

BA.note: Full service, current cabin, through bags, real irregular-ops desk

UA.note: Full service, ageing cabin on several transatlantic routes

AA.note: Pre-refresh widebody cabins on much of the Atlantic

KL.note: Current cabin, strong hub, single-terminal transfer

AF.note: Mixed cabin generations across the widebody fleet

LH.note: Consistent, punctual, dated seat on older frames

IB.note: Adequate hard product, slower recovery when it goes wrong

TP.note: Adequate hard product, weaker punctuality record

EI.note: Narrowbody transatlantic, US preclearance at DUB

VY.note: Low cost, no interline, thin recovery

FR.note: Low cost, no interline, separate ticket by construction
